# 易漢學

**ID:** KR1a0156
**Custom ID:** ZB1a0153
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V52.2, p301
**Extent:** 8 卷

## Authors / Editors
- 惠棟 (清朝) 撰 1697 - 1758

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The principal Qiánlóng-period reconstruction of Hàn-school *Yìjīng* learning, in eight juàn, by [惠棟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%83%A0%E6%A3%9F) Huì Dòng (1697–1758), the *Wú pài* 吳派 master. The work systematically gathers and reconstructs the *Yì* doctrines of the four major Hàn commentators: [孟喜](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AD%9F%E5%96%9C) Mèng Xǐ (Chángqīng 長卿) — 2 juàn; [虞翻](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%99%9E%E7%BF%BB) Yú Fān (Zhòngxiáng 仲翔) — 1 juàn; [京房](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BA%AC%E6%88%BF) Jīng Fáng (Jūnmíng 君明) — 2 juàn; with [干寶](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B9%B2%E5%AF%B6) Gàn Bǎo attached; [鄭玄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%84%AD%E7%8E%84) Zhèng Xuán (Kāngchéng 康成) — 1 juàn; [荀爽](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8D%80%E7%88%BD) Xún Shuǎng (Címíng 慈明) — 1 juàn. The eighth juàn is Huì's own elucidation of the Hàn *Yì*-principle, used to refute the Sòng *Hé tú-Luò shū* and *xiāntiāntài jí* doctrines.

The work's organizational principle: Yú Fān is placed after Mèng Xǐ on the basis of Yú's biography (he claimed to be the fifth-generation transmitter of Mèng Xǐ's *Yì*); Zhèng Xuán is placed after Jīng Fáng on the basis of the *Hòu Hàn shū*'s noting that Zhèng was conversant with Jīng's *Yì*; Xún Shuǎng is given his own juàn as a representative of the [費直](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%B2%BB%E7%9B%B4) Fèi Zhí line.

The *Sìkù* editors give a substantive historiographic discussion of the Hàn *Yì*-tradition: noting that the post-[田王孫](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%94%B0%E7%8E%8B%E5%AD%AB) Tián Wángsūn split into [施讐](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AE%90) Shī Chóu / Mèng Xǐ / [梁丘賀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%A2%81%E4%B8%98%E8%B3%80) Liáng Qiūhè was already a fragmenting; noting [劉向](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8A%89%E5%90%91) Liú Xiàng's testimony that all *Yì*-houses originally derived from [田何](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%94%B0%E4%BD%95) Tián Hé with broadly common doctrine and only Jīng Fáng's was a "deviant party" (異黨); concluding that "the Hàn-learning's having Mèng-and-Jīng [as separate-traditions] is just like Sòng-learning's having Chén-and-Shào ([陳摶](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%99%B3%E6%91%B6) Chén Tuán and [邵雍](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%82%B5%E9%9B%8D) Shào Yōng): both are what is called 'separately-transmitted *Yì*-tradition outside [the canonical *Yì*]'" (易外別傳). The Fèi Zhí line, by contrast, transmitted through [陳元](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%99%B3%E5%85%83) Chén Yuán, [鄭眾](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%84%AD%E7%9C%BE) Zhèng Zhòng, [馬融](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%A6%AC%E8%9E%8D) Mǎ Róng, Zhèng Xuán down to [王弼](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%BC%BC) Wáng Bì — the present standard recension. The editors conclude that the work is methodologically substantive enough to be classified in *jīng* 經 (canon) rather than relegated to *zǐbù shùshù* 子部術數 (technical-numerology), even though the Mèng / Jīng material is technically of the divinatory tradition.

**Abstract**

Composition is bracketed by Huì Dòng's middle-and-late career through his death in 1758. The bracket here adopts a span from his early forties through his death.

The work is the foundational Qiánlóng-period reconstruction of Hàn-school *Yìxué*, written in tandem with the *Zhōuyì shù* ([KR1a0155](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0155)) — where the latter is Huì's own integrated *zhùshū* commentary, the *Yì Hàn xué* is the documentary-historical reconstruction of the source-Hàn-tradition that the *Zhōuyì shù* draws upon. Together they constitute the principal *Wú pài* *Yìxué* corpus.

The *Sìkù* editors' classificatory decision — to keep the Mèng / Jīng material in the canonical-classics (*jīng* 經) section rather than relegating it to the technical-numerology (*shùshù* 術數) sub-canon, despite acknowledging that strictly the doctrine "ought to be returned to *shùshù*" — is methodologically significant: it accepts Huì's reconstruction as a substantive contribution to canonical *Yìxué* even where the underlying source material is non-canonical. This is one of the more important Qiánlóng-court editorial endorsements of the *kǎozhèng* school.

The work's reception was decisive for late-Qing and Republican-period *Yìxué*. The Mèng / Yú line that Huì reconstructed became the basis for [張惠言](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BC%B5%E6%83%A0%E8%A8%80) Zhāng Huìyán's more thorough Yú Fān reconstruction, and through Zhāng for the late-Qing *jīnwén* school's *Yìxué* ([廖平](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BB%96%E5%B9%B3) Liào Píng).
